title: Indian Economy Physical Demand Radar
description: Ground-truth physical activity telemetry from DPIIT 8-Core, Major Ports, Fuel Freight, and FASTag mapped to Sector Demand and Equities.

dpiit_eight_core.report_title: DPIIT Index of Eight Core Industries

ppac_fuel_freight.report_title: PPAC Monthly Petroleum Industry Consumption Review

netc_fastag_toll.report_title: NETC FASTag National Highway Toll Telemetry

sector_demand_matrix.macro_correlation_note: Diesel consumption (+5.6%) aur Highway FASTag toll collections (+8.5%) commercial freight activity mein continuous expansion ko darshate hain. Historically, jab fleet utilization 85%+ cross karta hai, commercial vehicle manufacturers ke dispatches aur tonnage volumes mein positive trend dekha jata hai.
sector_demand_matrix.fundamental_metric_to_track: MHCV Production/Dispatch Volumes & Fleet Tonnage Realization
sector_demand_matrix.primary_indicators: PPAC Diesel (HSD): +5.6% YoY • FASTag Toll: +8.5% YoY
sector_demand_matrix.economic_rationale: High-Speed Diesel consumption aur Highway FASTag toll collections mein robust growth national freight volume expansion ko reflect karta hai.

sector_demand_matrix.macro_correlation_note: National electricity generation (+11.4%) double-digits par hai aur coal dispatch (+10.7%) multi-month high par hai. Industrial shift operations badhne se baseload thermal utilities ka Plant Load Factor (PLF) increase hota hai aur heavy equipment transmission order execution accelerate hota hai.
sector_demand_matrix.fundamental_metric_to_track: Plant Load Factor (PLF) & Transmission/Distribution Inflow Orders
sector_demand_matrix.economic_rationale: Industrial power consumption aur commercial base-load growth double-digits par chal raha hai. Grid transmission aur heavy equipment makers ke order books full hain.

sector_demand_matrix.macro_correlation_note: Cement output (+9.8%) aur Bitumen consumption (+17.2%) highway capex aur post-monsoon construction activity ka sharp pickup reflect karte hain. Fixed plant capacity utilization badhne par cement manufacturing companies ke operating metrics me volume leverage positively reflect karta hai.
sector_demand_matrix.fundamental_metric_to_track: Quarterly Cement Dispatches (MMT) & Blended Operating Costs
sector_demand_matrix.primary_indicators: 8-Core Cement: +9.8% YoY • Bitumen Road Capex: +17.2% YoY
sector_demand_matrix.economic_rationale: Post-monsoon highway construction, central capex execution, aur residential housing absorption se cement volume dispatch multi-month highs par hai.

sector_demand_matrix.macro_correlation_note: IPA Major Ports total cargo (+10.17% YoY, 566.4 MMT) aur Container throughput (+8.51%) domestic trade volume expansion ko validate karte hain. Ports ke capital-intensive nature ke chalte incremental container handling efficiency operating margins ko positively influence karti hai.
sector_demand_matrix.fundamental_metric_to_track: Container TEU Throughput & Non-Major Port Dry Bulk Volume
sector_demand_matrix.primary_indicators: IPA Major Ports: 566.4 MMT (+10.17% YoY) • Containers: +8.51%
sector_demand_matrix.economic_rationale: Major ports cargo traffic double-digit growth par hai, POL aur containerized volumes dono mein sharp acceleration dikh raha hai.

sector_demand_matrix.macro_correlation_note: Domestic steel production (+4.9%) aur Iron Ore output (+18.4%) infrastructure capex aur auto manufacturing demand ko support karte hain. Global export market pricing pressure ke bawajood domestic volume consumption steady rehta hai.
sector_demand_matrix.fundamental_metric_to_track: Crude Steel Finished Production Volumes & Raw Material Input Costs
sector_demand_matrix.economic_rationale: Domestic infrastructure capex, automotive demand, aur pre-engineered buildings domestic steel production ko support kar rahe hain.

sector_demand_matrix.macro_correlation_note: Fertilizer production output mein -11.7% YoY ki seasonal girawat aayi hai. Post-Kharif seasonal destocking aur international raw material import parity ke chalte fertilizer manufacturing plants ke operating capacity utilization mein temporary reduction notice hota hai.
sector_demand_matrix.fundamental_metric_to_track: Quarterly Production Run-rates & Subsidy Working Capital Cycle
sector_demand_matrix.economic_rationale: Post-Kharif seasonal inventory destocking aur international raw material import parity ke chalte fertilizer plant operating rates mein contraction aya hai.

sector_demand_matrix.macro_correlation_note: Domestic crude oil (-1.4%) aur natural gas (-4.6%) production mein slight de-growth dekhi gayi hai, jo mature offshore fields ke natural depletion aur operational maintenance cycles ko reflect karta hai.
sector_demand_matrix.fundamental_metric_to_track: Daily Oil Equivalent (BOE) Production Volumes & Realized Prices
sector_demand_matrix.economic_rationale: Mature field output declines aur delayed offshore development production volumes ko constrain kar rahe hain.
